data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Develop a real-time dashboard using Chart.js to display live metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard updates in real-time with new data.
Includes line chart for LLM cost over time.
Stage completion rates are shown with a bar chart.

features.title: Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Integrate Chart.js to display various data visualizations such as pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are displayed using an 8-stage pipeline chart.
Cost tracking is visualized with a line chart showing LLM cost over time.
Success rates are represented with an area chart.

features.title: Display Real Metrics
features.description: Showcase real metrics from recent runs using actual data in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are sourced from recent data runs.
Data is presented accurately and clearly.
Charts reflect the most up-to-date information.

features.title: Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Display code quality metrics such as TDD compliance and SOLID principles using a radar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart includes metrics for TDD compliance.
SOLID principles are represented in the chart.
Chart is clear and easy to interpret.

features.title: Auto-Advance and Navigation Controls
features.description: Implement auto-advance functionality and navigation controls for the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration.
Users can manually navigate between slides using controls.
Navigation controls are intuitive and responsive.

features.title: Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Create a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for the Artemis demo.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file includes all necessary CSS and JavaScript inline.
Chart.js is embedded and functional within the HTML file.
Presentation is self-contained and does not rely on external resources.

features.title: Professional Presentation Design
features.description: Design the presentation with a professional gradient background and smooth transitions.
acceptance_criteria: Background uses a professional gradient design.
Transitions between slides are smooth and visually appealing.
Design elements are consistent throughout the presentation.

features.title: Integration Visualization
features.description: Show supervisor integration across stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents integration data.
Chart is interactive and updates with new data.
Integration stages are clearly labeled.
